description: Return the catalog of registered metric views (bundles) that can be used with the derived-metrics time-series endpoints. Each view represents an opinionated set of derived metrics (e.g., 'core_fundamentals', 'liquidity', 'efficiency'). Catalog metadata identifies whether a view is EDGAR-only safe or requires external market inputs. View codes are not the metric-bundle codes of GET /v1/edgar/metric-bundles; an unknown view code is refused with its valid codes in details.valid_codes.
name: views_metrics
title: List registered metric views (bundles)
